title: Exact-anchor deterministic editing
mechanism: Make the model quote one exact, unique source span and propose its replacement. Let deterministic code validate and apply the replacement instead of asking the model to operate a general editing tool.
experiment: Measure proposal parse rate, unique-anchor rate, and successful file-change rate before spending a benchmark call.
risks: A narrow source excerpt can hide necessary context, so reject rather than guess when the anchor is absent or ambiguous.

sources.name: Darwin Godel Machine
sources.lesson: Discovered more granular file viewing and precise string-replacement editing.

sources.name: Claude Code hooks
sources.lesson: Put deterministic enforcement in lifecycle code rather than relying on model compliance.

title: Trace-first root-cause analysis
mechanism: Compare the failing trace with the task rubric and real implementation, identify the first divergence, and change the general mechanism responsible for that divergence.
experiment: Require the hypothesis to name one observed failure, one real source location, and one predicted behavior change.
risks: Benchmark fixtures are evidence only; copying their functions into Morph is a false improvement.

sources.name: SICA Archive Explorer
sources.lesson: Compare iterations, best and worst problems, change logs, and detailed traces before choosing a modification.

title: Generate, filter, then verify
mechanism: Generate several small competing patches from clean contexts, reject structurally invalid proposals, and evaluate only the strongest surviving candidate.
experiment: Generate three candidates assigned different strategy priors; compare their static validity before selecting one for target preflight.
risks: Candidate count must stay small because local Gemma inference and benchmark calls are expensive.

sources.name: Claude Code dynamic workflows
sources.lesson: Generate-and-filter, tournaments, and adversarial verification reduce self-preferential single-context failures.

sources.name: Darwin Godel Machine
sources.lesson: Multiple attempts followed by model-based selection emerged as a useful workflow improvement.

title: Bounded relevant source context
mechanism: Extract a small set of real source windows around symbols named in the diagnosis. Keep task evidence, history, planning, and implementation in separate bounded contexts.
experiment: Track source-context size and whether the selected anchor was present verbatim in the supplied excerpt.
risks: Over-aggressive truncation can remove cross-module constraints; include several relevant files but cap the total.

sources.name: Darwin Godel Machine
sources.lesson: Long-context management was one of the automatically discovered improvements.

sources.name: Claude Code subagents
sources.lesson: Specialized isolated contexts prevent side-task material from flooding the implementation context.

title: Independent mechanical verification
mechanism: Keep validation independent of the proposing model: enforce path policy, syntax, protected files, fixture boundaries, exact-target gain, conformance, and global non-regression in code.
experiment: Record the first deterministic gate that rejects each candidate and feed that evidence back as experience.
risks: Visible evaluation can be overfit, so retain protected and eventually held-out checks.

sources.name: Claude Code dynamic workflows
sources.lesson: Use adversarial verification and quarantine agents that consume untrusted public content from high-privilege actors.

sources.name: Huxley-Godel Machine
sources.lesson: Decouple candidate expansion from evaluation and stop spending evaluations on unpromising agents.
